matchedRules.cssText: .home-page, .home-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.home-page__guest-avatar { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 27px; height: 27px; border-radius: 50%; color: white; background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgb(91, 179, 255), rgb(37, 99, 235)); }
